question: 单项选择：I have _____ finished my work. A. already  B. yet  C. just  D. A and C
answer: 答案：D. A and C。解析：already/just都可用于现在完成时肯定句。already"已经"，just"刚刚"。

question: 单项选择：Have you seen him _____? A. recently  B. lately  C. just now  D. A and B
answer: 答案：D. A and B。解析：recently/lately"最近"用于现在完成时。just now（刚才）用于一般过去时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (have not, see) him recently.
answer: 答案：haven't seen。解析：recently是现在完成时标志。完整：I haven't seen him recently.

question: 单项选择：So far, I _____ three books this month. A. read  B. reads  C. have read  D. am reading
answer: 答案：C. have read。解析：so far"到目前为止"是现在完成时标志。

question: 翻译句子：到目前为止我已经学了十个单元。
answer: 答案：So far I have learned ten units. 解析：so far"到目前为止"是现在完成时标志。

question: 单项选择：I haven't seen him _____. A. already  B. yet  C. just  D. still
answer: 答案：B. yet。解析：yet用于现在完成时否定句句末。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (have, just) come back from school.
answer: 答案：has just。解析：just"刚刚"用于现在完成时。完整：She has just come back from school.

question: 单项选择：I have _____ visited many places this year. A. already  B. yet  C. ever  D. never
answer: 答案：A. already。解析：already用于现在完成时肯定句。

question: 翻译句子：最近我一直在学英语。
answer: 答案：I have been studying English recently. 解析：recently"最近"，现在完成进行时或现在完成时皆可。

question: 单项选择：Have you _____ been to the United States? A. ever  B. yet  C. just  D. already
answer: 答案：A. ever。解析：ever"曾经"用于现在完成时一般疑问句。
